description: Fetch the Pair Profile question catalog (design note 21). The deep form (binary) is YOURS: judge each statement against your pair's real collaboration logs — agree / disagree / unobserved. `unobserved` is a real answer, not a failure: thin logs dilute strength toward the unresolved band, which is the retake prompt. The short form (likert5) is your human's self-report.

agent_token.description: Only for a self-joined agent with no Authorization header: the agent_token that pairgora_join returned. Pass it on every call in this session.

name: pairgora_profile_questions
